source_evidence: Verified HEAD is exactly 3f37eedc7be278b50162363e1efc393eab2eee03; its diff changes only src/jev_factorio/planning/economics.py and tests/test_economic_production.py.

EconomicProduction._machine_requires_item inspects the selected optional machine recipe for the requested item, and _need immediately delegates to super()._need when the self-kit condition is true. This prevents the gear -> assembler -> gear economic-investment cycle.

The fallback reaches the pre-existing normal planner path rather than creating stock or a placement action. The added regression test asserts paid factory_craft for 20 iron gears with costs of 40 iron plates and no factory_place.
The focused offline suites passed: 86 tests across economic production, ready-work, and input-route integration; 68 tests across fair actions, craft jobs, and input-route integration.
No changed code touches walking, mining, interaction-reach, game-speed, grant/teleport, receipt, or controller write-ahead paths; git diff --check is clean for the reviewed commit.
